summary: Keep strict kit-play case policy source-controlled in production and pass fixture policies explicitly through the test runner function.

replay.detail: CI test infrastructure only; no replay or rebuild.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: The production kit-play entry point rejects KIT_PLAY_CASE_OVERRIDES when set, including an empty value. Production requirements always use the reviewed source policy. Fixture tests use an explicit runner parameter when custom policy is needed; the critical-story rejection fixture includes the policy's aliases and kept base stories.
